Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful
O Allah, indeed I ask You

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيَّ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
Translation: O You who are closer to me than my jugular vein

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ
Translation: O You who intervene between a person and their heart

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ هُوَ بِالْمَنْظَرِ الْأَعْلٰى وَبِالْأُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ
Translation: O You who are at the highest viewpoint and the clear horizon

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ هُوَ الرَّحْمٰنُ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوٰى
Translation: O You who are the Most Merciful, established on the Throne
O You who has nothing similar to Him
And He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing

Arabic text: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
